# GreenSwap - Sustainable Living Platform
> GreenSwap helps users track and swap eco-friendly products to live sustainably and reduce waste.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://sustainable-app-qccf.vercel.app/) - Main sustainable living dashboard
- [Explore](https://sustainable-app-qccf.vercel.app/explore) - Discover eco-friendly products and swaps
- [About](https://sustainable-app-qccf.vercel.app/about) - Learn about our sustainability mission

## Documentation
- [How it Works](https://sustainable-app-qccf.vercel.app/about) - Detailed guide to sustainable swapping
